q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I would. The winning ideas behind the Nobel Prizes are often too complex for most people to understand. Good illustrations can draw people’s attention to the prizes and help them understand the complex ideas.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 回答愿意并给出表态（Yes, I would）
给出合理理由（如插画能帮助大众看懂复杂的研究）
examples: Good illustrations can help people understand the complex ideas.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题，答案不唯一。表明态度并给出合理理由即可，两点都答到得2分，只答一点得1分。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。参考答案选“愿意”：诺贝尔奖的研究很难懂，好的插图能吸引人，也能帮人看懂。你也可以选不愿意，只要理由合理。

evidence.quote: His job is to translate scientific ideas into drawings.
